$comment:
Purchasable titles. Six was a shop, not a catalogue: the economy simulation has a regular player earning 26,310 coins in ninety days against 6,000 of stock, so there was nothing left to want by about week three. Eighteen now.

All at `BALANCE.prices.titleUnlock`, and that is not laziness — `priceFor` returns one number for this kind and `catalogue.ts` DROPS any row that disagrees with it, deliberately, so that a pack cannot quietly give the shop away or price something out of reach. Varying title prices is an economy change and belongs in the balance table with a simulation run behind it, not here.

Titles rather than avatar items, map skins or themes, which is where the real money would go: `SELLABLE_KINDS` is `['title']` because "everything else has no artwork or no runtime", and the twelve avatars that DO ship are already free in Settings — selling those would be taking something away. A title costs nothing to make and is the one cosmetic this app can honestly stock today.

Names are flavour and never rank. The level ladder in `titles.json` is earned and must stay earned, so nothing here reuses one of its ten words.
